verdict.rationale: A registrar could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, such as portfolio or renewal suggestions or AI domain-name recommendations, so this story applies to Porkbun. The evidence documents an official MCP server, an API, and agent-oriented guides that let external AI clients act on the account. None of it shows AI-generated insights or suggestions produced inside Porkbun itself, so the external-agent tooling is not credited here.
